label: National Pension contribution rate
appliesTo: Employees, including most foreign nationals. Some nationalities are exempt by treaty.
why: Half is the employer's cost and half is deducted from pay, so the employee side is always this figure divided by two. The first increase since 1998 landed in 2026 and English-language guides still carry the old 9%. It is also the one social insurance rate whose future is already fixed in law rather than negotiated annually, which is why the path to 2033 is recorded separately below rather than left to be rediscovered each January.
